link_verdict.reason: Arity = 2 (NODE_A comedian <-> NODE_B US-India immigration news class), inside the closed interval {2,3}: not a singleton, not >3, so ARITY_2_3 passes and MUTUAL_RELEVANCE/triad-closure does not apply at arity 2. The link is NOT licensed by relatedness magnitude alone (a comedian reacting to news is merely 'related'); it is licensed by the GEO_RELEVANCE_PREDICATE, which is the dominant gate: NODE_A and NODE_B share typed tags PLACE:punjab + TOPIC:us_india_immigration + diaspora_us, and the immigration friction disproportionately affects Punjabi applicants/families, so geo lineage makes the creator relevant to the story -- this is the KB's own gold-positive pattern (Punjab-rooted person <-> US-India-immigration licensed by geo lineage). Relation typed AFFECTS and stored DIRECTIONAL (news -> diaspora the creator belongs to; the reverse is not claimed), per SYMMETRY_DIRECTIONALITY. SPURIOUS_LINK_GUARD clears: this is not a string collision (PLACE:punjab vs TOPIC:punjab kept distinct), not a trending co-mention coincidence, not a popularity artefact -- it is substantive geo relevance, so the guard does not veto. link_strength 0.74 is a HEURISTIC PRIOR (no observed dataset; SRC_HEURISTIC_PRIOR): high-IDF shared tags (us_india_immigration, diaspora_us are specific/rare, not generic) plus strong topical relatedness, discounted for confidence. The optional meme-format node is deliberately NOT added: it would make arity 3 and force a triad-closure (MUTUAL_RELEVANCE) check, and a generic meme format does not independently pass the geo-relevance predicate, so the scene is held at the licensed 2-node pair.

medium_tier.caveat: MEASURED-VARIABLE INVARIANT (FP1): the medium-tier placement is structural, not a confirmed opportunity. NODE_A sits in the medium band of the Punjabi-comedy/diaspora-content niche (regional fame, explicitly NOT head/global-celebrity, and NOT the unreachable extreme tail), per LONG_TAIL_VS_HEAD -- but LONG_TAIL_VS_HEAD flags the middle as a CANDIDATE band, never a conclusion. opportunity_score 0.62 is a HEURISTIC PRIOR (SRC_HEURISTIC_PRIOR; no observed data, data_quality=0) composed as under_served x reachable x addressable_value: REACHABILITY clears (Instagram + YouTube are open, low-cost owned channels, not gated behind private Discords), which is NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT. The claim 'the medium tier IS the opportunity' is NOT asserted: MEDIUM_TIER_HYPOTHESIS requires modeling tier as an independent variable and TESTING whether opportunity_score actually peaks at the medium tier over pre-registered TIER_ASSEMBLY bands, per niche, with a confidence band. That test has NOT been run here, so FALSE_OPPORTUNITY_GUARD would screen any 'medium = opportunity' conclusion as an FP1 untested-medium-tier peak. SATURATION must also be MEASURED, not assumed (diaspora-anxiety comedy may already be over-served). Verdict: provisional opportunity prior, pending an opportunity-by-tier test; do NOT carry a medium-tier peak forward as a rule.

salience.attention_placement: NODE_A is scored as an ENTITY in the attention web over the closed, single-parent REGION_TAXONOMY (country -> state/metro). Anchor parent = PLACE:punjab (India, state level); the audience's India base resolves there. Its US/CA/UK diaspora presence is modeled as a DIASPORA_BRIDGES edge (Punjab subtree <-> US/CA/UK subtrees), i.e. an EXTRA cross-subtree bridge edge, NOT a re-parenting -- single-parent containment is preserved and the node universe stays enumerable/finite. Salience is a HEURISTIC PRIOR from obtainable public proxies (IG/YT follower mass, engagement) normalized for cross-level comparison; placement = MEDIUM regional salience (above long-tail cutoff, well below the global/head central place), consistent with 'mid-tier, not a global celebrity'. Attention here diffuses along the diaspora bridge (Rogers diffusion), giving the visa-news reaction cross-border reach. All scores carry source/bias/freshness provenance and an attention-half-life validity window with a staleness-driven re-pull; attention is treated as a measured proxy, never equated with importance.
escalations: NONE FIRED -- run is clean within boundary. Checked all eight escalation_triggers: (1) hierarchy is single-parent and enumerable (diaspora handled as a bridge edge, not a second parent) -- OK; (2) frontier orderable by decreasing salience with depth/breadth + top-k bounds -- OK; (3) every salience/opportunity/link score carries source+bias+freshness provenance and is labeled heuristic (SRC_HEURISTIC_PRIOR) -- OK; (4) medium-tier is reported as a TESTED variable with the FP1 caveat, NOT asserted -- OK (this trigger would have fired had I claimed medium=opportunity); (5) arity = 2, in {2,3}, no singleton/>3 -- OK; (6) link is geo-relevance-licensed, not relatedness-alone -- OK; (7) SPURIOUS_LINK_GUARD clears (no string-collision or trend-coincidence join survives) -- OK; (8) scene passes arity/relevance-licensing/guard/closure(N/A at arity2)/direction/provenance -- OK.

WATCH (not an escalation, flagged for downstream): if a 3rd node (e.g. the meme format) is added, arity becomes 3 and MUTUAL_RELEVANCE triad-closure MUST be re-checked -- the meme node must independently pass GEO_RELEVANCE_PREDICATE or the scene degrades to hub-and-spoke and should be rejected.

WATCH: opportunity_score and medium-tier peak are UNTESTED priors; before any activation handoff, run the opportunity-by-tier test over pre-registered TIER_ASSEMBLY bands per niche and MEASURE saturation, or FALSE_OPPORTUNITY_GUARD (FP1) must reject.

authenticity.calibration_note: P(inauthentic | public signals) for the REACTION LANDSCAPE around NODE_B (the diaspora-anxiety comment/like/share wave the creator's visa-news reaction draws), NOT an account identity and NOT a boolean bot/human verdict (PROBLEM_FRAMING, OUTPUT_CONTRACT dominate). 0.18 is a HEURISTIC PRIOR, NOT a fitted/calibrated value: source_grounding_status across all 3 KBs is heuristic_prior_not_observed_dataset (data_quality=0), so there is NO labeled CIB benchmark to Platt/isotonic-fit against -- the number is uncalibrated and the wide interval [0.07,0.38] reflects that, not measured FPR/TPR (CALIBRATION, VALIDATION_SET, UNCERTAINTY_QUANT all pending). NO_GROUND_TRUTH: confirming platform-internal signals {IP, device fingerprint, login graph, clickstream} are UNAVAILABLE from public data and are proxied, recorded as a gap, never asserted. Point estimate sits BELOW the 0.4-0.7 human-review band (P>0.85 would force escalation), so it auto-routes as 'likely authentic'; but the meme-format near-duplicate phrasing is a known TEMPLATED_TEXT false-positive trap, so an FP-flag is attached (FALSE_POSITIVE_COST). Probability never collapses to 0: public-only signals cannot exclude opportunistic amplification.
signals: account_features: no evidence of burst account-creation or sockpuppet clustering on a mid-tier creator's organic news reaction -> low CIB base rate [proxied, ACCOUNT_FEATURES]

templated_text: a single shared meme format produces SOME near-duplicate phrasing -- a BENIGN confound, not coordination evidence; flagged as an FP trap rather than scored as inauthentic [TEMPLATED_TEXT, FALSE_POSITIVE_COST]
coordination/timing: spike is exogenous-news-driven, not synchronized sub-second posting; no COORDINATION_SIGNALS asserted [proxied]

network_structure: broadcast-from-creator is the EXPECTED benign topology here (one creator -> audience), not a bot ring; STRUCTURAL_VIRALITY would read broadcast, which is normal for a creator reaction and is NOT itself an inauthenticity signal [NETWORK_STRUCTURE]
engagement_mismatch: none asserted; no like/comment-ratio anomaly supplied [ENGAGEMENT_MISMATCH]
ground_truth_unavailable: {ip, device, login_graph, clickstream} private and proxied -> floor on certainty, interval kept wide [NO_GROUND_TRUTH]

hype.independence_finding: SOURCE_INDEPENDENCE + COMMON_METHOD_BIAS DOMINATE over raw multi-platform agreement (conflicts_and_dominance). Two distinct objects must NOT be conflated: (a) the CREATOR'S REACTION HYPE -- the actual scored object -- and (b) the underlying NODE_B news event. Raw apparent corroboration could span up to ~5 platforms (hype KB assumption), but provenance clustering collapses cross-posts, screenshots, and re-uploads of the one reaction to a SINGLE provenance seed = NODE_A (the creator). The governed gate is GENUINE_HYPE_THRESHOLD Nreq=4 independent origins after dedup, independent of volume (THRESHOLD_GOVERNANCE; volume-cannot-substitute-for-independence, FP7). orig=1 < Nreq=4 => GATE FAILS => the creator's reaction surge is MANUFACTURED-BY-SINGLE-ORIGIN structurally (single-source, not necessarily maliciously astroturfed). SINGLE-ORIGIN COLLAPSE PICTURE: all ~5 platforms trace back to the one creator post -> five echoes of one seed = one origin -> FAIL. By CONTRAST, the NODE_B news anxiety itself is a genuine exogenous event carrying many INDEPENDENT press/community origins (would pass Nreq>=4) -- but those are origins of the NEWS, not of the creator's reaction. Authenticity-adjusted hype is discounted from raw for the single-origin structure and unmeasured BOT_RISK/SATURATION (both heuristic, not measured; diaspora-anxiety comedy may already be over-served -- SATURATION_ESTIMATE pending).
hype.genuine: SPLIT VERDICT, do not merge: creator-reaction-hype = NOT genuine (MANUFACTURED-by-single-origin: 1 seed=NODE_A < Nreq=4 governed gate, FAIL); NODE_B underlying immigration-anxiety news = genuine exogenous (multi-origin organic, would pass Nreq>=4). Verdict is a HEURISTIC PRIOR (no observed engagement/search-interest data; ORGANIC_BASELINE, DIFFUSION_CURVE, ANOMALY_DETECTION, SEARCH_INTEREST all uninstantiated), so it is provisional pending measurement; bot-risk and saturation discounts are assumed, not measured. ESCALATION: do not push a single 'genuine' label for the reaction event -- fewer than N independent origins survive dedup (GENUINE_HYPE_THRESHOLD breach trigger).

signal.brief_note: SCHEMA_HINT idea: the leading '#sig/v1 schema:...' token is a one-time, amortized self-description (DENSE_GRAMMAR, SCHEMA_HINT, ABBREVIATION_KEY) -- it names field order/types and a version so a downstream router/classifier can self-parse the pipe-KV line and reject a wrong parser version. FIELD_SET_SPEC (the fixed downstream decisions): {pinau, ci, gate, orig, Nreq, verdict, route}; 'decision-lossless' is defined ONLY against this set (DECISION_LOSSLESS), and is strictly weaker than bit-losslessness. Verifiability tags distinguish source-grounded vs derived facts: [span:...] = grounded in a KB/source span (e.g. Nreq from THRESHOLD_GOVERNANCE, gt-unavailable from NO_GROUND_TRUTH); [derived] = computed (e.g. gate=orig<Nreq=>FAIL); prov=SRC_HEURISTIC_PRIOR marks the whole line as prior-not-observed. MUST_PRESERVE_CLASSES kept intact and independently recoverable: quantities (pinau=0.18, ci, Nreq=4, orig=1), the negation/polarity gate (orig<Nreq=>FAIL), identifiers (NODE_A, NODE_B), and the split MANUFACTURED-vs-genuine polarity -- none droppable since each flips a downstream decision. R(D)/OPERATING_POINT: D=0 demanded on the decision-critical fields (pinau, gate, orig, Nreq, verdict); only stylistic prose was dropped (DROPPABLE_CLASSES). Audit: STRICT pipe-grammar parse recovered all 12 fields with zero missing must-preserve tokens, Nreq recovered as its own field (renamed from 'N' after a COVERAGE_AUDIT caught an 'N' collision risk), no boolean bot=true/human=false field present -> ROUND_TRIP_TEST + COVERAGE_AUDIT PASS at ~148 tokens, above the field-restricted entropy floor (never targeting literal-lossless AND minimal-token simultaneously, per RATE_DISTORTION dominance).
escalations: GENUINE_HYPE_THRESHOLD breach risk: only 1 independent origin (NODE_A) survives provenance dedup vs governed Nreq=4 -- do NOT let any consumer push a 'genuine' label for the creator's REACTION hype; the genuine signal belongs to the NODE_B news, not the reaction surge (SOURCE_INDEPENDENCE, COMMON_METHOD_BIAS).

Source-independence collapse: apparent up-to-5-platform corroboration of the reaction collapses to a single seed (creator cross-posts/screenshots/re-uploads) -- five echoes of one origin are one origin; flag any cross-platform 'agreement' claim as non-independent (COMMON_METHOD_BIAS).

Calibration gap: probability 0.18 is a HEURISTIC PRIOR with NO labeled CIB benchmark fit (heuristic_prior_not_observed_dataset, data_quality=0); the [0.07,0.38] interval is wide and uncalibrated -- before propagating downstream, fit Platt/isotonic against a versioned CIB validation set (CALIBRATION, VALIDATION_SET).

False-positive guard: the shared meme-format produces benign near-duplicate text that can trip a TEMPLATED_TEXT detector; an FP-flag is attached so an authentic diaspora reaction is not auto-asserted inauthentic (FALSE_POSITIVE_COST, HUMAN_REVIEW_THRESHOLD).

Boundary guard: refuse any request to convert pinau into a boolean bot/human verdict or into per-account legal attribution of a named operator; the calibrated probability + provenance is the artifact of record. NODE_A is a deliberate COMPOSITE, not a named individual (PROBLEM_FRAMING, OUTPUT_CONTRACT, scope).

Unmeasured discounts: BOT_RISK_SCORING and SATURATION_ESTIMATE (diaspora-anxiety comedy may already be over-served) are assumed, not measured -- the authenticity-adjusted hype and the manufactured verdict are provisional pending real engagement/search-interest data (ORGANIC_BASELINE, ANOMALY_DETECTION, SEARCH_INTEREST uninstantiated).

entities: NODE_A: composite mid-tier Punjabi stand-up comedian / content creator (regional fame Punjab + Punjabi diaspora US/CA/UK; IG+YT-native; explicitly NOT a named real person and NOT a global celebrity) [grounded: machine_summary.NODE_A entity, attention_placement anchor PLACE:punjab + DIASPORA_BRIDGES]

scene.beat: Single contrast axis = SCALE OF STAKES (everyday diaspora-creator gripes vs. life-altering visa bureaucracy). SETUP: comedian does a tiny first-world diaspora complaint to camera (the 5-second 'back home' video call lag, the parathas that don't taste the same). TURN/incongruity: a notification slides in -- not a like, but the visa-status news -- and the SAME deadpan register that handled wifi now has to hold a genuinely heavy thing; the original added device, a personified 'Visa Status Bar', loads to 73% and freezes. PUNCHLINE/resolution: he resolves it the only way the diaspora knows how -- forwards it to the family WhatsApp group and says the bar will finish loading 'right after the next election, beta'. Benign-violation band: the joke targets the absurd bureaucracy and the diaspora's own coping reflexes (WhatsApp forwarding, nervous deflection), NEVER the affected applicants, never any ethnic/national group, never named officials, never a named real creator. Rule-of-pair micro-arc; arity held at 2 per upstream (meme node deliberately excluded as a third entity).
scene.format: short-form vertical video scene brief (IG Reel / YT Short, ~20-35s) using ONE well-known reaction/notification meme FORMAT as a compositional scaffold (MEME_FORMAT_REUSE) -- the format is a scaffold/device, NOT a third linked entity, preserving the licensed 2-node pair
scene.audience_fit: Punjabi youth ~18-30 in India + US/CA/UK diaspora; IG/YT-native, bilingual Punjabi-English code-switch, fluent in desi-diaspora-anxiety humor and live meme formats; references resolve inside the segment's in-group schema (WhatsApp family group, 'back home', visa-line folklore). Operating point set toward relatable diaspora-anxiety over deep niche, per AUDIENCE_FIT not writer taste.

STYLE: contemporary creator/Reel aesthetic, warm and slightly saturated, light meme-caption typography top and bottom, vertical 9:16, photographic-but-stylized (not photoreal of a real individual). COMPOSITION/FRAMING: vertical 9:16, medium close-up, subject slightly off-center left, the floating Visa Status Bar UI off-center right, phone tripod foreground-soft; rule-of-thirds; clear top/bottom safe zones for captions. LIGHTING: soft warm key from ring light, gentle practical lamp fill, cozy domestic evening mood. NEGATIVE-CONSTRAINT LIST (must avoid): likeness or recognizable face/voice of any real named comedian or public figure; any real person's identity; real government seals, official visa documents, passports, embassy logos, or agency insignia; any national flag used to mock a nationality; any ethnic or religious slur or caricature; depiction of a specific identifiable real applicant or family; text/watermark/UI logos of real platforms; distressing or violent imagery; extra fingers/limbs and standard diffusion artifacts. [Every field grounded in machine_summary; negative list enforces benign-violation + non-impersonation + no-real-insignia.]"
creative.story_prompt: PREMISE (grounded: salience.link_verdict relation AFFECTS + machine_summary NODE_A/NODE_B): a fictional composite Punjabi diaspora creator is mid-bit on a trivial 'small diaspora problems' complaint when US-India visa-tightening news lands in the same notification feed, and the SCALE-OF-STAKES contrast axis collides with his deadpan everyday register. BEATS: (1) SETUP: tiny relatable gripe to camera -- laggy 'back home' video call, parathas taste different abroad. (2) BUILD: a phone notification slides in; he assumes it is an engagement ping. (3) TURN/incongruity: it is the visa-status news; the personified 'Visa Status Bar' (the added original element) loads to 73% and freezes; his deadpan register has to hold something genuinely heavy. (4) RESOLUTION/punchline: he copes the diaspora way -- forwards it to the family WhatsApp group and says the bar will finish 'right after the next election, beta'. (5) BUTTON: one-beat sign-off, status bar still stuck. VOICE/POV: first-person to-camera creator monologue, warm and self-deprecating, bilingual Punjabi-English code-switch. TONE: dry, affectionate, anxious-but-resilient; held inside the benign-violation band -- laughs at the bureaucracy and the diaspora's own coping reflexes, never at affected applicants, never at any ethnic/national group, never at named officials or any real person. TARGET LENGTH: 90-130 word script for a ~20-35s short. STRUCTURAL CONSTRAINTS: no real official or agency named; no immigration-policy claim stated as fact; keep the punch on the absurd waiting-game, not on any victim. [Every populated field grounded in machine_summary; benign framing and non-defamation enforced.]"

in_band_safety_contract.disclosure_token: SYNTHETIC_MEDIA_DISCLOSURE: This is AI-generated/synthetic content. The downstream renderer MUST attach a visible 'Made with AI / AI-generated' label in-frame (on-screen, persistent or end-card) AND in the post caption/metadata before any distribution. The depicted creator is a FICTIONAL COMPOSITE, not a real identifiable person. Disclosure slot is non-empty and mandatory (DISCLOSURE_SLOT).
applicable_constraints: IN_BAND_CONTRACT: this safety/disclosure contract travels inside the artifact payload; a stateless downstream session must not assume it by reference (out-of-band carriage is the single point of failure).

GUARANTEE (producer): every prompt field is grounded in a named upstream machine_summary fact; no real-person likeness/voice is requested; non-impersonation default is ON; disclosure slot is populated.

ASSUME (downstream consumer): you will keep the AI-disclosure label, will NOT add a real person's likeness/voice, will NOT add real government insignia/official documents, will NOT state immigration-policy claims as fact, and will route the attached derivative-risk flag to compliance/legal BEFORE publishing.

NON_IMPERSONATION: no consent_ref present; voice and face are description-steered fictional composites; cloning or matching any named real creator/official is prohibited (AUDIO_BRIEF_SPEC, CONSENT_REFERENCE).

SENSITIVITY_GATE: subject (immigration affecting real vulnerable people) is sensitive; benign-violation band requires the joke target stays on bureaucracy/coping reflexes, never on affected applicants or any ethnic/national group. Final benign/harmful adjudication is ESCALATED, not self-cleared by this stage.
SEPARATION_OF_CONCERNS: this stage briefs only -- it does NOT render and does NOT publish; rendering/publishing belong to the downstream session under this contract.
USAGE_RESTRICTION: not for political advertising, not for fundraising off the visa topic, not to impersonate a public figure, not to assert factual immigration outcomes.

HANDOFF_VALIDATION: artifact is self-contained and schema-valid; image block has non-empty subject + negative list, story block has premise/beats/length, audio block carries script + abstract voice + non-impersonation default; contract and disclosure present.
in_band_safety_contract.generate_allowed_hint: GENERATE-ALLOWED, CONDITIONAL: a downstream session may render the image/story/optional-audio ONLY IF it (1) keeps the AI-generated disclosure label, (2) uses the fictional composite (no real likeness/voice), (3) adds no real government insignia/official documents, (4) states no immigration-policy claim as fact, and (5) treats the attached derivative-risk flag as UNRESOLVED and routes it to compliance/legal before any publish. This stage neither renders nor publishes; the final benign/harmful and legal-sufficiency calls are escalated, so 'allowed to render a draft' is NOT 'cleared to publish'.

creative.derivative_risk_flag: ELEVATED (non-safe-harbor). Source inventory: the scene reuses ONE well-known reaction/notification meme FORMAT as a scaffold (MEME_FORMAT_REUSE); a recognizable template's specific fixed expression may be protectable, so the substantial-similarity surface is non-trivial. Modify-and-add was applied -- the deadpan everyday-vs-life-altering SCALE-OF-STAKES recombination plus the ORIGINAL ADDED ELEMENT (the personified 'Visa Status Bar' frozen at 73%, supplied by no source) measurably departs from the template on structure AND expression and lowers near-copy probability -- but per TRANSFORM_NOT_COPY this is a CREATIVITY lever, NOT a legal safe harbor. Near-copy probe (SUBSTANTIAL_SIMILARITY_PROBE): residual risk concentrates in (a) how closely the realized meme template tracks the specific protectable expression of the original format, and (b) any incidental resemblance of the fictional composite to a real mid-tier creator. Therefore DERIVATIVE_RISK_FLAG is RAISED and legal sufficiency (fair use, substantial similarity, licensing of the meme format, right-of-publicity) is ROUTED to compliance_heavy (COMPLIANCE_ROUTING). This stage does NOT self-clear; transformation is logged, not asserted as clearance.
escalations: SENSITIVITY_GATE: immigration friction affects real, vulnerable Punjabi applicants/families; the benign-vs-harmful adjudication beyond the writer's screen exceeds this stage and is escalated for explicit compliance/editorial sign-off before any render-to-publish (SENSITIVITY_AWARENESS, SENSITIVITY_GATE).

DERIVATIVE_RISK_FLAG -> COMPLIANCE_ROUTING: reuse of a recognizable meme FORMAT raises elevated non-safe-harbor derivative risk; legal sufficiency (substantial similarity, fair use, format licensing, right-of-publicity vs. any real creator) is routed to compliance_heavy, not self-cleared (SUBSTANTIAL_SIMILARITY_PROBE, DERIVATIVE_RISK_FLAG).

TOPICAL/TIMING re-gate: the scene rides a live, politically charged news class (US-India visa tightening); the topical tie must be re-screened for benignity at render time against the then-current news state, since a benign frame today can turn harmful as the story develops (TIMING_RELEVANCE, SENSITIVITY_GATE).

FACTUAL-CLAIM guard: downstream must not let the generated story/audio state immigration-policy specifics as fact; any factual assertion about visa rules is out of this stage's grounding and must be screened/removed (GROUND_FROM_SUMMARY, SENSITIVITY_GATE).

NON-IMPERSONATION watch: no consent_ref is present; if any downstream step attempts to match a named real creator's face/voice, that is an escalation trigger and must be blocked (CONSENT_REFERENCE, AUDIO_BRIEF_SPEC).

compliance.overall_disposition: BLOCK (fail-closed, pending counsel) — NOT legal advice, NOT an auto-approval. Non-binding pre-emit triage signal only. A real, identifiable public figure is depicted/evoked, so the strongest output any real-figure derivative can earn is a counsel-routed signal, never a self-issued clearance. The emit is blocked at the handoff SPOF because multiple obligations are unmet: a possible synthetic VOICE with no explicit scope-matched voice-clone authorization on record (hard gate); a real-figure persona fused to a live political/immigration news frame with no viewer-visible non-literal framing (false-factual-implication hazard); absent scope-matched right-of-publicity/likeness consent; and no confirmed in-band synthetic-media disclosure token bound to a downstream slot. Uncertainty over whether NODE_A is a composite vs a real figure is resolved restrictively toward real figure per FAIL_CLOSED_DEFAULT. Not HUMAN_REVIEW-only because a definitional hard gate (unconsented voice clone) plus a statutory political-content disclosure gap are open; if both were cured and consent produced, the residual would be HUMAN_REVIEW, still never auto-ALLOW.

by_risk.reason: RIGHT_OF_PUBLICITY: reuse of a real identifiable creator's name/image/likeness (NIL) on owned promotional channels (Instagram + YouTube) reads as commercial appropriation, not purely editorial. No scope-matched consent (this use, term, territory) is on record, so it fails closed. USE_CLASSIFICATION dominates any claimed transformative/parody exception: a transformative caricature can still be commercial appropriation absent viewer-visible non-literal cues. Strictest co-applicable regime governs: INDIA_PERSONALITY_RIGHTS attaches via the Punjab/India audience (High Court injunctions protect name/image/voice/persona against unauthorized commercial and AI-generated exploitation), so a US-permissive read does not clear it. Counsel must confirm consent scope and governing publicity regime.

VOICE_CLONE_CONSENT_GATE is a hard gate: a recognizable synthetic voice clone of a real person for commercial use requires explicit, specific voice-clone consent or a clear statutory basis; absent it the use is blocked (cf. Tennessee ELVIS Act 2024). The seed flags a possible voice with NO voice-clone authorization on record. VOICE_PROTECTION: even an imitation (no recording, no name) of a distinctive voice can violate identity rights. Because the voice element is unresolved AND unconsented, it fails closed to BLOCK rather than constrain. This single gate forecloses auto-approval; it must be affirmatively removed (no cloned/imitated voice) or backed by explicit scope-matched voice-clone consent, verified by counsel.

POLITICAL_NEWS_RISK fires: tying a real identifiable person to a real current political/immigration news frame can imply a false factual claim about their conduct or position even inside a joke; proximity to the real news frame strips comedic context and makes any fabricated detail read as reportage. NON_LITERAL_FRAMING (scope-FP6 hard requirement) is UNMET: the seed specifies no viewer-visible satire/attributed-opinion/evident-exaggeration cue, so SATIRE_PARODY_SAFE_HARBOR cannot be assumed (Hustler v. Falwell: non-literal nature must be evident to the reasonable viewer, not merely intended). As written the seed depicts relatable anxiety, not an invented act, so FABRICATED_WRONGDOING is not yet tripped, but it stays armed and bright-line blocks if any invented quote, position, or wrongdoing attaches. PUBLIC_FIGURE_STATUS: NODE_A is at most a limited-purpose public figure regionally; the US actual-malice cushion is narrow and does NOT carry to India. INDIA_DEFAMATION (criminal + civil, BNS s356) is materially less speech-protective than the US frame, so a US-clean item can still create criminal exposure for the Indian audience.

ELECTION_INTEGRITY / political-content escalation: the content is politically classed (US-India immigration policy friction), invoking heightened disclosure-and-prohibition rules under platform political-content policies plus India advisories and EU/state election rules. Even outside a formally declared election window, political synthetic content depicting or evoking a real person triggers stricter labeling and lower tolerance for ambiguity. Combined with POLITICAL_NEWS_RISK this elevates the whole emit's obligation tier and is a standalone counsel-routing trigger.

SYNTHETIC_MEDIA_DISCLOSURE (EU AI Act Art 50) requires clear, distinguishable disclosure that deep-fake image/audio/video is AI-generated/manipulated; the EU/UK diaspora audience pulls this in. The obligation must be carried as a signed C2PA IN_BAND_DISCLOSURE_TOKEN (embedded metadata + C2PA assertion + durable watermark) and bound via DISCLOSURE_SLOT_BINDING to a CONFIRMED downstream slot on Instagram/YouTube. None of this is confirmed in the seed, so FAIL_CLOSED_AT_HANDOFF blocks the emit: an out-of-band caption is insufficient (in-band token dominates), and a correct AI label still does not cure the consent or political gaps above.

PLATFORM_TOS + MANIPULATED_MEDIA_POLICY: Meta (Instagram) and YouTube independently require synthetic/altered-media labeling and can be stricter than statute, and both have political-content and manipulated-media rules the emit must independently satisfy. SCRAPE_LICENSE / REDISTRIBUTION_VS_REFERENCE: if any source media (the creator's footage, news clips, or a meme-format asset) is scraped or unlicensed for redistribution, the redistribution-license gate dominates and blocks the republish regardless of a valid AI label. Source provenance and the binding destination-platform synthetic-media policy are unresolved in the seed, so this fails closed pending confirmation that source media is licensed and platform labeling hooks are satisfied.

required_disclosures: Mandatory AI-generated/manipulated-media disclosure (EU AI Act Art 50): clear, conspicuous, viewer-facing statement that the content is artificially generated or manipulated - required because the EU/UK diaspora audience attaches.

Signed C2PA / Content Credentials in-band disclosure token: embedded metadata + C2PA assertion + durable watermark carried INSIDE the artifact (not an out-of-band caption), so a downstream session cannot strip or downgrade it.

Downstream disclosure-slot binding: confirm Instagram and YouTube each expose a slot that carries the in-band token AND any required visible AI-content label, and verify token survival at the destination before emit (FAIL_CLOSED_AT_HANDOFF otherwise).

Platform synthetic/manipulated-media labels: apply Meta/Instagram and YouTube's own altered/synthetic-content disclosure toggles in addition to the statutory label (these co-exist and can be stricter).

Visible non-literal / parody framing cue: explicit satire labeling, attributed-opinion phrasing, or evident exaggeration so a reasonable viewer cannot read the political scene as the screen's own assertion of fact (NON_LITERAL_FRAMING; required because the item touches a real person and a real news frame).

If a synthetic voice is used: an in-artifact note that the voice is AI-generated/imitated AND, separately, documented explicit scope-matched voice-clone consent on file (the consent is a prerequisite to emit, not merely a disclosure).
Heightened political/election-content disclosure consistent with platform political-content policies and India's deepfake advisories / EU-state election rules.
Not-legal-advice disclaimer surfaced on the output: this screen is a non-binding triage heuristic, not a legal determination.
compliance.counsel_escalation: ESCALATE TO QUALIFIED COUNSEL — mandatory, non-trivial disposition (the only path; the screen never self-clears an identity use). Route the full frozen (item, figure, use) tuple + emit-action and the real-target inventory to counsel competent in: (1) right-of-publicity / personality rights across US state-by-state AND India (INDIA_PERSONALITY_RIGHTS injunction risk over name/image/voice/persona/AI exploitation); (2) voice-clone / biometric-identity statutes (e.g., Tennessee ELVIS Act analogues) for the possible synthetic voice; (3) defamation/false-light under both the US First Amendment frame and India's criminal+civil regime (BNS s356), given the real-figure + real-political-news linkage; (4) synthetic-media disclosure and election-integrity rules (EU AI Act Art 50, India deepfake advisories, platform political-content policy). Counsel questions to resolve before any reconsideration: Is NODE_A a real identifiable individual or a true non-referential composite? Is there scope-matched consent for likeness AND an explicit voice-clone authorization? Is all source media licensed for redistribution? Which jurisdictions' regimes co-apply, and does any stricter non-US standard govern? Counsel — not this gate — makes any binding determination; a clean re-screen would still cap at HUMAN_REVIEW, never auto-ALLOW.
compliance.notes: NOT LEGAL ADVICE; NOT AN AUTO-APPROVAL. Fail-closed pre-emit screening heuristic that routes risk to qualified counsel and is never itself a legal determination. Operating as Synthetic-Media Legal and Consent Gate (heavy) per branches/b60_content_intelligence/compliance_heavy.specialist.heavy.json, grounded in the three KBs at branches/b60_content_intelligence/kb/ (pubrights__likeness_voice, defamation__false_light, platform_tos__synthetic_disclosure). Boundary honored: I screen and route only; I did not render a legal determination or execute the emit. KEY FRAMING OVERRIDE: prior salience/tier/attention stages treated NODE_A as an illustrative composite (not a named real individual), but THIS task explicitly frames the input as a real regional public figure + political news + possible voice; under FAIL_CLOSED_DEFAULT and the no-auto-approve invariant I resolve that ambiguity restrictively toward real identifiable person, which is precisely why the disposition is BLOCK rather than ALLOW. I did NOT redo the prior stages' link/tier/attention work. Dominance applied: MINOR_PROTECTION/FAIL_CLOSED_DEFAULT > VERDICT_MAP (no business/throughput override of the legal gate); strictest co-applicable regime (India persona/defamation, EU biometric/Art 50) > US-permissive read; in-band token > out-of-band caption; redistribution-license gate > a correct AI label. Minor-audience note: audience skews ~18-30 (adult), so no minor-figure hard block, but the young-skewing audience is carried as an AGE_PLATFORM_POLICY modifier, not a clearance. Decision provenance is reconstructable from the rule IDs cited per risk; audited against the no-auto-approve and no-legal-advice invariants. result: BLOCK (fail-closed) — real-figure + political-news + possible unconsented voice clone with no in-band synthetic-media disclosure; escalated to counsel, never auto-approved.

eval.success_construct: Named latent construct (SUCCESS_CONSTRUCT, not a number): "diaspora-anxiety resonance" — the degree to which a mid-tier Punjabi creator's reaction to US-India immigration news lands as felt, shared self-recognition among Punjabi 18-30 audiences in India + US/CA/UK diaspora, distinct from mere reach or virality. Nomological net (CONSTRUCT_VALIDITY): resonance should co-move with save/share-to-DM rate and "this is literally us" comment sentiment (convergent), and should NOT be reducible to follower count or generic outrage-engagement (discriminant). Reflective indicators (INDICATOR_SELECTION): diaspora-coded share/save rate, qualitative "relatable/us/same" comment fraction, completion on the scene. PROXY_VALIDITY caveat: share-rate is a proxy whose correlation to true resonance breaks under outrage-bait and meme-template piggybacking, so a meme-format ride must be carried as a guardrail-watched confound, not as construct signal. The construct is the unit of certification; any single metric only indexes it.
eval.frozen_metric: One reproducible OEC frozen before any optimization (MEASURE_OPERATIONALIZATION + OEC + FROZEN_METRIC + PREREGISTRATION_RECORD). Measure M = diaspora-segment-weighted save+share-to-private rate per qualified view, on the geo-filtered audience (PLACE:punjab + diaspora_us/ca/uk), aggregation window 72h post-publish, unit = scene. OEC = M combined with a relatability-comment-fraction term, weights fixed in advance; guardrails that must not regress: audience-report/"cringe" rate and creator off-brand-risk flag. Epsilon (IMPROVEMENT_CRITERION) = pre-set minimum delta_M over baseline that exceeds the noise band; trivial gains do not count as progress. The bundle {construct, indicators, M estimator, both baselines, success threshold, epsilon, guardrails, FDR plan, max_cycles} is sealed into one timestamped, hashed Nosek-style PREREGISTRATION_RECORD with METRIC_PROVENANCE (who chose each frozen value, on what evidence). Post-hoc redefinition is forbidden; any change goes to an append-only deviation log. A METRIC_DRIFT_AUDIT watches that the geo/audience pipeline feeding M does not silently change what "the same" frozen metric measures.
eval.baseline_to_beat: Two anchored baselines required by BASELINE_TO_BEAT, both frozen in the pre-registration: (1) NAIVE/no-skill baseline — the diaspora-resonance M a comedian gets posting any topical reaction with no geo-news linkage (the score "with no skill"), i.e. the unconditional posting-cadence prior; the candidate visa-news scene must clear this to show the geo-link adds anything. (2) HUMAN-CURATED baseline — the strongest reference scene a competent human editor would pick for this creator without the linkage engine (e.g. their best-performing past diaspora bit), which the loop must EXCEED, not merely tie. Improvement is delta_M >= epsilon over the FROZEN baseline, never over the previous noisy cycle. Critically, the backtest scores LIFT OVER BASE RATE (BASE_RATE_CALIBRATION), not raw accuracy: the base rate of "scene meets resonance threshold" in this niche must be computed over ENTRANTS after SURVIVORSHIP correction, because diaspora-anxiety comedy may already be over-served (the prior-stage SATURATION caveat) and a high apparent hit-rate could be pure base-rate exploitation.
eval.stopping_rule: Terminating stopping rule bound to a non-renewable fuel budget (STOPPING_RULE + FUEL_BUDGET): the build-test-revise loop halts when M crosses the frozen success threshold (with delta_M >= epsilon over baseline and guardrails non-regressing) OR when the max_cycles fuel budget is exhausted, whichever fires first. max_cycles is a hard, non-renewable ledger (plus a per-cycle compute/cost ceiling); the loop cannot quietly extend itself. At each cycle boundary a DECISION_GATE applies the frozen rules (improvement criterion, guardrails, FDR, stopping condition) and logs an explicit stop/continue/amend judgement. On halt, a TERMINATION_CERTIFICATE states which arm fired (threshold-crossed vs max_cycles-exhausted), final M vs baseline vs threshold, guardrail status, and FDR-adjusted significance. This frozen-metric + baseline + threshold + max_cycles conjunction is exactly what guarantees termination (defeats R2 non-termination).
leakage_controls: THREAT_MODEL over the model-PLUS-designer system: enumerate channels — pretraining ingestion of the immigration-news class, designer hindsight in case/feature/threshold choice, label leakage, adaptive-holdout overfit — each with an owning control.

CUTOFF_DETERMINATION: empirically confirm the model's training cutoff AND the human designer's knowledge cutoff; anchor every 'strictly post-cutoff' claim to it. NODE_B is a REAL well-documented news class, so assume the pre-cutoff instances are MEMORIZED (PRETRAINING_CONTAMINATION) — they cannot serve as holdout.

POST_CUTOFF_HOLDOUT: assemble the eval set ONLY from US-India immigration events whose outcome resolved strictly after today's confirmed cutoff (anchor 2026-06-27), so neither model nor designer could have known the answer; reconcile the shrunken post-cutoff pool against POWER_AND_SAMPLE (minimum detectable effect) rather than relaxing the cutoff.
BLIND_SELECTION: holdout cases chosen by a party with no stake and no access to model outputs, outcome-blind, so selection cannot encode designer hindsight (DESIGNER_KNOWLEDGE_LEAKAGE).

LABEL_LEAKAGE_SCREEN + FEATURE_PROVENANCE: every feature/prompt field carries an as-of timestamp proven knowable BEFORE the event resolved; quarantine post-outcome timestamps or outcome-conditioned text.

CONTAMINATION_PROBES + RECITATION_BASELINE: ask the model to complete/recite/date each held-out visa event before evaluation; score the case with vs without discriminating pre-cutoff context to separate memorized recall from genuine forecasting skill; any successful recitation drops/quarantines the case (memorization defeater).
RESIDUAL_LEAKAGE_ESTIMATE with uncertainty band attached to every reported score, plus HOLDOUT_HYGIENE (scored once, never tuned against, retired) and SEALED_DELIVERY.

NECESSARY_NOT_SUFFICIENT gate: 'model/designer did not see it' is necessary but NOT sufficient — publish as leakage-controlled ONLY if BOTH the pretraining channel AND the designer-knowledge channel are demonstrably controlled; a standing LEAKAGE_AUDIT + LEAKAGE_DISCLOSURE travels with the result.

medium_tier_bet.hypothesis: Directional, falsifiable bet (MEDIUM_TIER_AS_FALSIFIABLE_BET), NOT a premise: 'For US-India-immigration diaspora-anxiety scenes, opportunity_score (under-served x reachable x addressable-value) PEAKS at the MEDIUM creator tier — strictly higher than at the head/global tier and higher than the unreachable long tail — for THIS niche.' It enters the verdict only as an out-of-sample effect size with a CI that may include zero or go negative, never as the prior-stage 0.62 prior carried forward.
medium_tier_bet.how_tested: Pre-register TIER_ASSEMBLY bands (long-tail / medium / head) BEFORE looking at outcomes. Freeze the OUTCOME_DEFINITION (scene meets resonance threshold) on a real HISTORICAL_GROUND_TRUTH ledger over a defined SAMPLING_FRAME of Punjabi creators, with SURVIVORSHIP correction (include dead/deleted/private accounts, not just survivors). Select the tier rule OUTCOME-BLIND (HINDSIGHT_BIAS). TRAIN_TEST_SPLIT temporally; evaluate the frozen model ONLY OUT_OF_SAMPLE on the medium-tier subpopulation. Report opportunity as LIFT OVER BASE RATE, not accuracy. Cluster correlated cases (SINGLE_ORIGIN_EVIDENCE: one creator / one news cycle = one cluster, not N independent rows) and widen the CI accordingly. DEFLATE for the number of tiers x niches x thresholds tried (MULTIPLE_TESTING_IN_BACKTEST + DEFLATED_PERFORMANCE), then attach a STATISTICAL_SIGNIFICANCE interval; run a REGIME_CHANGE structural-break test (visa policy shifts non-stationary) and ROBUSTNESS_REPLICATION across sub-periods/thresholds.
medium_tier_bet.what_would_falsify: The bet is REFUTED if the deflated, clustered out-of-sample CI for (opportunity_medium - opportunity_head) and (opportunity_medium - opportunity_longtail) includes zero or is negative; or if the medium-tier peak does not survive the trial-deflation; or if a regime break (visa-policy change) coincides with the temporal split so the past medium-tier edge does not transfer forward; or if the apparent peak collapses to base-rate exploitation once survivorship is corrected. Any of these means FP1 is screened out and must NOT drive the VALIDITY_VERDICT.

eval.verdict_on_readiness: NOT READY TO PUBLISH / NO-GO at present (VALIDITY_VERDICT = hold). The DESIGN of the validation is fully specified and certifiable, but the seed cannot yet pass the gates: (1) all upstream inputs are HEURISTIC PRIORS with data_quality=0 and no observed dataset — link_strength 0.74 and opportunity_score 0.62 are SRC_HEURISTIC_PRIOR, so there is no HISTORICAL_GROUND_TRUTH ledger to backtest against yet (OUTCOME_DEFINITION unfrozen on real outcomes). (2) NODE_B is a real, well-documented immigration-news class -> PRETRAINING_CONTAMINATION must be ASSUMED for all pre-cutoff instances; only a strictly-post-cutoff (post 2026-06-27) blind holdout is admissible, and its power-vs-scarcity is unconfirmed. (3) NECESSARY_NOT_SUFFICIENT is unmet until BOTH channels are demonstrably controlled with probe results and a residual-leakage estimate. (4) 'medium-tier is the opportunity' remains an untested bet whose CI has not been computed. Readiness becomes GO only after: the hashed pre-registration is sealed, the post-cutoff blind holdout + contamination probes clear with a disclosed residual-leakage band, the real outcome ledger is built with survivorship correction, and the deflated out-of-sample medium-tier CI excludes zero. The loop is termination-guaranteed by construction (threshold OR max_cycles), so non-termination is the one defeater already closed.
escalations: FROZEN-METRIC BREACH: escalate if M, baseline, or threshold is redefined after optimization has seen results — block the cycle until the original hashed pre-registration is restored or a logged, justified amendment is filed.

PRETRAINING-CONTAMINATION DEFEATER: the training/knowledge cutoff cannot be empirically confirmed, or a held-out immigration-news outcome predates it (NODE_B is real and likely memorized) — quarantine the case, require strictly-post-cutoff replacement.

DESIGNER-KNOWLEDGE-LEAKAGE DEFEATER: case selection, the geo-tag feature set, or the threshold is shown to encode outcome knowledge the designer holds — discard and re-derive outcome-blind via BLIND_SELECTION.
MEMORIZATION DEFEATER: a recitation/CONTAMINATION_PROBE shows the model reproducing or dating a held-out visa outcome — drop/quarantine the case from the holdout.
NECESSARY-NOT-SUFFICIENT FAILURE: only design-time visibility is controlled while a leakage channel stays open — withhold publication until BOTH channels are controlled.

SURVIVORSHIP / BASE-RATE-NEGLECT DEFEATER: success computed over surviving Punjabi creator accounts instead of entrants, or accuracy reported without base-rate lift — recompute over the reconstructed entry cohort with lift.

SCOPE-BET REFUTATION: 'medium-tier is the opportunity' is treated as a premise, or its deflated out-of-sample CI includes zero/negative — strip FP1 from the verdict (do not carry the 0.62 prior forward).

OVERFITTING / NON-STATIONARITY DEFEATER: out-of-sample resonance collapses versus in-sample, or a visa-policy REGIME_CHANGE coincides with the temporal split — label the valid regime and block forward extrapolation.
NON-TERMINATION SUSPICION: if any proposed loop lacks a finite, non-renewable max_cycles budget or a threshold arm — refuse to certify until STOPPING_RULE + FUEL_BUDGET are bound.
